x: (who had beaten us in the "Southern") had their sixth man behind our eighth, that Salford had three men well up but the others were not prominent, that Birchfield Harriers, Champions on so many occasions, were far from happy with two men only in the earlier placings and CURRIE, Midland Champion, retired from the race.

Currie the Midland champion, had retired at 1½ miles, and they had two men in the first bunch, the rest nowhere! However, we have been deceived before by the wearing of white vests and so were not unduly jubilant.

The start of the Invitation 800m at the White City, Whitsun 1956. From the inside (right): Hewson the British Champ., John Davies, Sventgali of Hungary the European Champ., Mugosa of Hungary, Roger Moens the Belgian World Record holder, Currie ? cf Oxford, and two others.
